'''Ivaylo (Ivo) D. Dinov''' ({{langx|bg| Ивайло Д. Динов}}) is a [[Mathematical statistics|mathematical statistician]], data scientist, and [[computational neuroscientist]],<ref>{{cite web |url= https://orcid.org/my-orcid?orcid=0000-0003-3825-4375| title= ORCID Profile: Ivo Dinov |publisher= orcid.org |access-date=July 30, 2024}}</ref> who is the [[Henry Philip Tappan]] collegiate professor at the [[University of Michigan]].<ref>{{cite web |url= https://mcommunity.umich.edu/person/dinov | title= Henry P. Tappan Collegiate Professor |publisher= umich.edu |access-date=July 30, 2024}}</ref> He is a co-developer of the 5D spacekime model, a new technique for complex time (kime) representation, modeling, and analysis of repeated measurement longitudinal processes.<ref name="dinov_velev_2021">{{cite book |last1=Dinov |first1=Ivo |last2=Velev |first2=Milen |date=2021 |title=Data Science - Time Complexity, Inferential Uncertainty, and Spacekime Analytics |location=Boston/Berlin |publisher=De Gruyter |isbn=9783110697803 |doi=10.1515/9783110697827 |url=https://www.degruyter.com/document/doi/10.1515/9783110697827/html}}</ref> Dinov is the author of the [[Data Science and Predictive Analytics]] (DSPA) book and has published significantly on a wide range of topics, including [[mathematical modeling]], [[computational statistics]], data science, neuroscience, applied statistics, and [[generative artificial intelligence]] models (GAIMs).<ref>{{cite web |url= https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=DYIQNOcAAAAJ&hl=en | title= Dinov's GoogleScholar Profile |access-date=July 30, 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url= https://dimensions.umich.edu/discover/experts_publication?search_mode=content&or_facet_profiles_author=957 | title= Dinov's Michigan Experts Profile |publisher= umich.edu |access-date=July 30, 2024}}</ref>

== Education ==
In 1991, Dinov completed his undergraduate study in mathematics and informatics from [[Sofia University]] in [[Bulgaria]]. Under the supervision of Kenneth L. Kuttler, he wrote a master's thesis entitled "Bochner Integrals and vector measures" and received his MS in [[pure mathematics]] in 1993 from [[Michigan Technological University]]<ref>{{cite journal |last=Dinov |first=I.D. |date=1993 |title= Bochner Integrals and Vector Measures |url= https://doi.org/10.37099/mtu.dc.etdr/919 | doi = 10.37099/mtu.dc.etdr/919 | access-date= July 30, 2024 |website=MTU | publisher= mtu.edu | language=en|doi-access=free }}</ref> Advised by [[De Witt Sumners]] and Fred William Huffer,<ref>{{cite web | url= https://genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=70722 | access-date= July 30, 2024 |title=Mathematics Genealogy | publisher= nodak.edu | language=en}}</ref> Dinov completed his MS in statistics and PhD in mathematics degrees at the [[Florida State University]]. His doctoral dissertation was on "Mathematical and statistical techniques for modeling and analysis of medical data".<ref>{{cite web |last=Dinov |first=I.D. |date=1998 |title= Mathematical and statistical techniques for modeling and analysis of medical data |url= https://fsu-flvc.primo.exlibrisgroup.com/permalink/01FALSC_FSU/pag4dr/alma990256821810306576 |  access-date= July 30, 2024 |website=FSU  | publisher= lib.fsu.edu | language=en}}</ref>

Subsequently, Dinov was a [[postdoctoral fellow]] at the [[University of California, Los Angeles]] (UCLA). During his postdoctoral training at UCLA he received a T32 fellowship in neuroimaging and brain mapping, as part of the UCLA [[NIH grant#Training grants|Institutional National Research Service Award]]. <ref>{{cite web |last=Toga |first=AW |title= UCLA T32 Training Program in Neuroimaging (MH019950) |url= https://reporter.nih.gov/project-details/2800352 |  access-date= August 1, 2024 | website=NIH  | publisher= nih.gov | language=en}}</ref>

==Academic career==
Between 2001 and 2013, Dinov was a faculty in the departments of statistics and neurology at UCLA. In 2002, he founded the [[Statistics Online Computational Resource]] (SOCR).<ref name="SOCR_Science_2003">{{cite journal |last=Leslie |first=Mitch |date=2022 |title= EDUCATION: Statistics Starter Kit |journal=Science |volume=302 | issue=5651 |pages=1635 |doi=10.1126/science.302.5651.1635c | url=https://doi.org/10.1126/science.302.5651.1635c |url-access=subscription }}</ref><ref>{{cite web | url= https://socr.umich.edu/people/ | access-date= July 30, 2024 | title = SOCR | website= University of Michigan | publisher= umich.edu | language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite web | url= http://www.socr.ucla.edu/htmls/SOCR_Team.html | access-date= July 30, 2024 | title = SOCR Team | website= University of California, Los Angeles | publisher= ucla.edu | language=en}}</ref>

In 2013, Dinov joined the faculty at the [[University of Michigan]], where he has been serving in multiple academic leadership roles, including department chair, associate director of the Michigan Institute for Data Science,<ref>{{cite web | url= https://midas.umich.edu/faculty-member/ivo-d-dinov/ | access-date= July 30, 2024 | title = MIDAS AD | website= University of Michigan | publisher= umich.edu | language=en}}</ref> and chair of various University of Michigan faculty senate committees.<ref>{{cite web | url= https://facultysenate.umich.edu/committees/administration-evaluation-committee/ | access-date= July 30, 2024 | title = UM Faculty Senate | website= University of Michigan | date= 17 March 2020 | publisher= umich.edu | language=en}}</ref>

Dinov is an active member in several professional societies, including the [[American Statistical Association]] (ASA), [[International Association for Statistical Education]] (IASE), [[American Mathematical Society]] (AMS), [[American Physical Society]] (APS), and an honorary member (fellow) of the [[Sigma Theta Tau | Sigma Theta Tau International Society]]<ref>{{cite web | url= https://www.sigmanursing.org/advance-elevate/awards/honorary-membership | access-date= July 30, 2024 | title = Sigma Theta Tau International Society | website= STTI | publisher= sigmanursing.org | language=en}}</ref> and [[American Association for the Advancement of Science]] (AAAS). He is an elected member of the [[International Statistical Institute]] (ISI).<ref>{{cite web | url= https://www.socr.umich.edu/people/dinov/bio.html |  access-date= July 30, 2024 | title = Dinov's Bio  |website= University of Michigan | publisher= umich.edu | language=en}}</ref>

==Publications==
Some of Dinov's selected publications<ref>{{cite web |url= https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=DYIQNOcAAAAJ&hl=en | title= Dinov's GoogleScholar Profile |access-date=July 30, 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url= https://dimensions.umich.edu/discover/experts_publication?search_mode=content&or_facet_profiles_author=957 | title= Dinov's Michigan Experts Profile |publisher= umich.edu |access-date=July 30, 2024}}</ref> include the following:

* ''[[Data Science and Predictive Analytics]]'' book,<ref name="DSPA_2018">{{cite book|last1= Dinov|first1= Ivo|year=2018 | title= Data Science and Predictive Analytics: Biomedical and Health Applications Using R | url= https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-319-72347-1 | doi=10.1007/978-3-319-72347-1 | publisher= Springer|isbn= 978-3-319-72346-4}}</ref><ref name="DSPA_2023">{{cite book|last1= Dinov|first1= Ivo| year=2023 | title= Data Science and Predictive Analytics: Biomedical and Health Applications Using R | series=The Springer Series in Applied Machine Learning | url= https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-3-031-17483-4|publisher= Springer | doi= 10.1007/978-3-031-17483-4|isbn= 978-3-031-17482-7|s2cid= 256875731}}</ref> which has received [[Data Science and Predictive Analytics#Reception| multiple expert reviews]] and its editions in various digital, paperback, and hardcover formats have been read by over six million readers.<ref>{{cite book | url= https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-319-72347-1 | doi= 10.1007/978-3-319-72347-1 | title = DSPA Downloads | access-date= July 30, 2024 | date= 2018 | publisher= Springer | language=en | last1= Dinov | first1= Ivo D. | isbn= 978-3-319-72346-4 }}</ref>
* ''The Data Science: Time Complexity, Inferential Uncertainty, and Spacekime Analytics'' book<ref name="Dinov_Velev_TCIU_2021">{{cite book|last1= Dinov|first1= Ivo |last2= Velev| first2= Milen | year=2021 | title= Data Science: Time Complexity, Inferential Uncertainty, and Spacekime Analytics |url= https://doi.org/10.1515/9783110697827 | doi=10.1515/9783110697827  | publisher= De Gruyter STEM Series|isbn= 978-3-11-069782-7 }}</ref> covers a wide range of topics including motivation for doing data science, characteristics of big datasets, artificial intelligence concepts and tools, neuroimaging genetics, climate change, problems with time, definition of Kime, economic forecasting, wave functions, definition and properties of operators, Fourier transforms, Kaluza-Klein theory, contravariance, velocity, Schrodinger equation, Lorenz transformation, Heisenberg's uncertainty principles, spacekime analytics, linear modelling using tensors, inferential uncertainty, and information theoretic versus data science formulations.<ref name="Shanmugam_2022">{{cite journal |last1= Shanmugam |first1= Ramalingam | title= Book Review: Data science: time complexity, inferential uncertainty, and spacekime analytics | url= https://doi.org/10.1080/00949655.2022.2096228 | doi=10.1080/00949655.2022.2096228 | journal= Journal of Statistical Computation and Simulation |date= 2022 |volume= 93|issue= 1|pages= 209–210|url-access= subscription }}</ref>
* The article Methodological challenges and analytic opportunities for modeling and interpreting big healthcare data identified multiple scientific gaps and proposed novel modeling methods for complex healthcare data including heterogeneous imaging, genetic, clinical and phenotypic data elements.<ref name="Dinov_2016">{{cite journal |last1= Dinov |first1= Ivo | title= Methodological challenges and analytic opportunities for modeling and interpreting Big Healthcare Data| doi=10.1186/s13742-016-0117-6 | journal= GigaScience |date= 2016 |volume= 5|issue= 12|page= 12 |doi-access= free |pmid= 26918190 |pmc= 4766610 }}</ref>

== Personal life ==
In 2022, as coach of the University of Michigan Men's Water Polo,<ref>{{cite web | url= https://websites.umich.edu/~umpolo/about | title = Michigan Men's Water Polo | access-date= July 30, 2024 | website= University of Michigan | publisher= umich.edu | language=en}}</ref> Dinov led the [[Michigan Wolverines]] to a Big Ten Division title and was recognized as the "2022 Big Ten Division Men's Water Polo Coach of the Year".<ref>{{cite web | url= https://collegiatewaterpolo.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/2022MenClubAllConferenceTeam-1.pdf | title= 2022 Big-10 Collegiate Water Polo | access-date= July 30, 2024 | website= Collegiate Water Polo| publisher= collegiatewaterpolo.org | language=en}}</ref>
